High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]] (Decipher premium product, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Premium/Third Anthology/The Ultimate Power In The Universe.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeOHNOY0VNV2NCUXM/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>The Ultimate Power In The Universe.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,980 bytes, SHA-256 <code>3013ce8ace28afb5eaf0633e0f351e7ac5c1ffc180e2887c50cef859f26e95e3</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This actual credited physical scan is the matching main illustration on [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]. The separate published digital source [[:File:TA-D-theultimatepowerintheuniverse-decipher-archive.gif]] is preserved as a digital artifact. The objective’s incorrect digital 7-side formula is distinguished from all physical copies by [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], page 152. The original TIFF, master, credit and license remain unchanged.

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
